_comment: Each arm runs one published GP-BO recipe unchanged (src/spherevo/published_recipes.py) under the R-1
protocol (5 cold-start ZINC molecules, 25 steps, deterministic decoding); src/spherevo/published_arms.py.
This manifest is separate from scripts/cr/manifest.json so that the running campaigns' manifest stays
byte-identical. Driver: scripts/cr/cr_queue_pub.py (scripts/cr/cr_queue.py with wave 'p' admitted and
this manifest as default); output root results/guacamol/cr2026pub (own root, refused otherwise).
Every arm runs the 11 paper tasks x seeds 42-81 = 440 cells; 9 arms = 3,960 cells (round 2: + hvarfner_published_allobs, + 2 learned-noise Papenmeier arms); GPU host class.
timeout_s only catches hangs (classes as in manifest.json: 14400 s GP-continuous, 21600 s MSR-type).

arms.note: Vanilla BO (Hvarfner et al. ICML 2024), published default model + Ax acquisition settings (qLogNEI, 4 x (512 Sobol + 512 around best), sigma 0.1, maxiter 300), on the [p01, p99] box

MSR (Papenmeier et al. ICML 2025): reference GP (Gamma(2,0.15) outputscale, noise frozen at 1e-4, Positive lengthscale init sqrt(D)/10), cholesky_max_tries(9) fit with Adam fallback, published acquisition call, on the [p01, p99] box
MLE (scaled) (Papenmeier et al. ICML 2025): the MSR reference without RAASP, on the [p01, p99] box
SBO-Matern (RI) (Xu et al. ICLR 2025): GP_ARD_setls, UCB beta 1.5, optimize_acqf 10 x 1000, on the [p01, p99] box
spherical linear kernel (Doumont et al.) in the authors' molecular box [-8, 8]^256 with their fit and optimize_acqf call

TuRBO-1 (Eriksson et al. NeurIPS 2019) as released (turbo_1.py + gp.py port): paper GP and Adam fit, failure tolerance ceil(max(4, D)), min(100 D, 5000) numpy-seeded Sobol perturbations, TS of the predictive, q = 1, on the [p01, p99] box; every proposal counted

hvarfner_published with every observation (out-of-box cold starts included) in the qLogNEI baseline (pre-C2 behaviour; round 2, R2-5); both Hvarfner arms run, the one printed under the Hvarfner name is the higher mean over the 11 tasks of the per-task mean best score after 30 evaluations (RUN_RULES)

MSR as papenmeier_msr_reference with the Gaussian noise LEARNED (understanding-hdbo --no-noiseless; round 2, R2-6); all four Papenmeier variants run, the one printed follows the verification decision (exactly one noise variant passes -> that one; both pass -> learned)

MLE (scaled) as papenmeier_mle_scaled_reference with the Gaussian noise LEARNED (understanding-hdbo --no-noiseless; round 2, R2-6); all four Papenmeier variants run, the one printed follows the verification decision (exactly one noise variant passes -> that one; both pass -> learned)
